reference_terminology: Motor = PULSE-DERIVED COMMANDED REFERENCE. Not ground truth, not an actual angle, not encoder-verified.

yaw.scalar_attitude: fused_in_plane_yaw (per-tag fusion; pre-dates the rigid-board estimator)

static.note: yaw acquisition logged no roll/pitch: no gravity-tilt reference exists

secondary_filtered_diagnostics_DO_NOT_CO.note: Secondary only. Never substituted into the three-axis RAW comparison and never compared with a RAW out-of-plane derivative.

sync.Primary_Method_Note: Camera<->motor mapping taken from the serial event timestamps; never refitted by minimising camera-vs-motor residuals.

camera_motor.map: t_motor = a * t_camera_host + b   (Arduino micros in host perf_counter base)
camera_motor.fitted_to: serial motor events only; never to attitude residuals

imu_motor.fitted_to: gyro rate domain vs commanded rate; camera never used

estimator.grid: uniform resample at the median sample interval, mapped back

estimator.status: SECONDARY DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - never replaces the RAW finite difference and is never labelled a RAW accuracy
